sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission examined theft and misuse risks involving dangerous pharmaceutical drugs in WA Health facilities.
sentences.support: The purpose of this report is to consider more broadly the issue of theft and misuse of dangerous and addictive pharmaceutical drugs

sentences.text: It analysed notifications about missing or otherwise unaccounted-for restricted drugs at three metropolitan hospitals from 2013 to 2017.
sentences.support: This report considers notifications received from WA Health relating to discrepancies in Schedule 8 and Schedule 4 Restricted drugs

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that most reported discrepancies remained unexplained after investigation.
sentences.support: Analysis of WA Health notifications (Table 6) suggests that most drug discrepancies remain unexplained after investigation.

sentences.text: It considered poor records and failures to follow security and handling policies to be contributing factors.
sentences.support: the difficulties experienced by WA Health in explaining drug discrepancies is exacerbated by deficiencies in record keeping and compliance with policies

sentences.text: Its nine recommendations covered consistent policies, accountability, records, security, prompt reporting, skilled investigations, staff training and detection strategies.
sentences.support: Ongoing education and training be given to relevant staff in drug management, record keeping, reporting discrepancies and investigating discrepancies.

findings.quote: WA Health is unable to account to the Commission or the community for the majority of drug discrepancies.

notes: PDF page numbers differ from printed page numbers, particularly near the end. The cover has garbled lettering, but substantive summary, conclusions and recommendations are readable. Nine recommendations are lettered a to i.
